def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    pts={}
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if g[i][j]!=bg: pts.setdefault(g[i][j],[]).append((i,j))
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    def free(i,j):
        return 0<=i<h and 0<=j<w and g[i][j]==bg
    for c,p in pts.items():
        if len(p)<2: continue
        (i1,j1),(i2,j2)=p[0],p[1]
        di=(i2-i1)//max(1,abs(i2-i1)) if i1!=i2 else 0
        dj=(j2-j1)//max(1,abs(j2-j1)) if j1!=j2 else 0
        for si,sj in ((di,dj),(-di,-dj)):
            i,j=i1+si,j1+sj
            while free(i,j):
                out[i][j]=c; i+=si; j+=sj
    return out
